You've entered a bedroom.

You can make out a chest drawer. You shudder, but continue examining the room. You can make out an antique trunk. If you haven't noticed it already, there seems to be something there by the wall, it's a king-size bed. You wonder idly who left that here. But the thing hasn't got anything on it.

There is a closed wooden door leading east.
